providers.name: Galaxy, procedurally generated by scripts/generate-procedural-textures.mjs (no third-party material)

review.note: Checked live (2026-08-26): Voyager 2's closest approach to Nereid was 4.7 million km at ~43 km/pixel resolution — the moon (radius ~170 km) is barely resolved, nowhere near enough detail for any surface map, global or otherwise. Procedural texture uses a smooth hemisphere-contrast primitive (not noise) reflecting the literature's explicit 'dark hemisphere' explanation for Nereid's large photometric variability (Schaefer & Schaefer 2000), rather than generic random mottling.
